title: Supreme Court Number of Judges Act 1997

sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court Number of Judges Act 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

FACT XXXIII OF 1997
FACT XXXIII OF 1997
SUPREME COURT
(NUMBER OF JUDGES) ACT, 1997
An Act to
determine the number of the Judges
of the Supreme
Court of Pakistan
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
6th November,
1997]
No.F.22(96)/97-Legis., dated
6-11-1997.--The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 1st November, 1997, is hereby published for
general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--This Act may be called the Supreme Court (Number of Judges)
Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
